quarterly_data.quarter: Air Liquide press release: "BEYOND": Air Liquide accelerates lasting value creation (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New strategic plan BEYOND (2026-2030) targets: a CAGR of +10% (+/-2%) in recurring net earnings per share from end-2025 to end-2030 at 2025 exchange rates; a sales CAGR of +5% (+/-1%) over the period (at 2025 FX and energy price, including the scope effect of acquisitions), outpacing industrial production by a factor of 2 to 3; an operating margin improvement of +400 to +600 basis points over 2026-2030; a recurring ROCE (excluding strategic acquisitions) above 11% in 2030. Air Liquide plans industrial investment decisions for approximately €24 billion over the period, particularly in industrial projects backed by long-term contracts, plus a reinforced acquisition strategy; total capital allocation of over €40 billion over 2026-2030, more than half dedicated to higher industrial investments, bolt-on and strategic acquisitions.
quarterly_data.figure: EPS CAGR +10% (+/-2%); sales CAGR +5% (+/-1%); margin +400 to +600 basis points; ROCE above 11% in 2030; investment decisions approximately €24 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: Air Liquide press release: "BEYOND": Air Liquide accelerates lasting value creation (10-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BEYOND names Electronics and AI as one of four strategic markets (with Energy Transition, Healthcare and Space). Air Liquide describes itself as the leading supplier of industrial gases and advanced materials to the semiconductors industry (company claim) and expects to capture fast-growing demand driven by ever-larger fab projects, the more advanced materials required by evolving chip performance, and sovereignty policies encouraging fab development across regions; its innovation strategy lists advanced materials for semiconductors among its frontier technologies and it will extend its leadership in electronic precursors, the proprietary materials and molecules for manufacturing the most advanced semiconductors.
